BS09-015: The three fantastic figures appeared before me, exactly like what happened last time. -from the 5th paragraph of the final chapter of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS09-016: The Oblivion Dragons have been defeated... but that was only the trigger to a new form of terror.
BS09-017: Oblivion gives existence to Oblivion and reigns over it... A conclusion rife with contradictions.
BS09-018: When the Celestial Scythe is wielded by its rightful owner, innumerable lives turn into sparkling stars in one fell slice.
BS09-022: A sudden tempest developed with winds clashing at blinding speeds. Somehow, my guide and I managed to hold on to each other. No matter what happens, I must not let go of this blade! -from the 10th paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS09-023: This way, over here! If we move forward together with this guy, we should be just fine, even if we run into the Rowdy Vandals! He may be a giant, but he's gentle, so there's nothing to be afraid of.
BS09-025: Is it just me, or does it feel like we're being watched...?
BS09-026: This forest won't last much longer... We'll have to part ways here, Lolo.
BS09-027: Hearing the term 'Braver' makes me recall frightening memories of the previous world. -from the 13th paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS09-030: Suddenly, I heard the sound of despair. A terrible sound like the shattering of glass erupted from the Singing Diva's throat as she crumpled into the Guardian's arms... -from the 12th paragraph of chapter White in "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS09-032: The three servants of those who create the stars in the heavens shall transcend time and space to make their guided advent of destiny. What will that destiny be? A time of annihilation where nothing is left standing? Or a time of rebirth filled with the power of life?
BS09-033: Once an Invader, now he's part of the Singing Diva's advanced guard. He inspires his comrades-in-arms as he awaits the Braver's arrival.
BS09-035: he Singing Diva's vessel miraculously survived the crash landing. The savior was a giant form who thrust himself to get pinned beneath the ship as an emergency sacrifice.
BS09-036: A world that has lost its song now turns to the last remaining rays of light.
BS09-039: He says he has a lead on the Key's whereabouts.... Oh, never mind, it's nothing. Probably not worth listening to.
BS09-040: He may be violent, but he's a great help in times of emergency. Let's pass on the Beast Kingdom and move on to the Magic Kingdom; there we may find some tools to help in our research, or at least some weapons to protect ourselves.
BS09-041: Was I mistaken in my judgment? All the beasts that I had tried to help pierced me as an enemy blade. -from the 13th paragraph in chapter Yellow of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS09-042: It's not that I detest handsome men; I'm just not interested, that's all.
BS09-045: Leave the battle to the professionals; in the meantime, we need to find those Keys!
BS09-049: What's this?! He wrapped his own body in flames! Such genius! He must have gained this new strategy in Battle Ball.
BS09-050: Feast your eyes upon this glorious dance! Sure, fierce contests that make your muscles tense and your blood boil can be wonderful, but the truth is oftentimes they are quite indecent. This is more like recreation for the eyes.
BS09-052: Why is this...? As strong as the Sapphire Spirits are, they should be able to win against the forces of Empty Sky easily... Instead they waste their energies in killing each other, forcing them down the spiraling path to certain self-destruction... -from the 12th paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS09-054: How come this warrior never participated in the tournaments? If he entered, he would easily wipe the floor with the competition with record-breaking results.
BS09-055: A valley where the Dinosaurs head toward in their final moments; it is there where the dead are reborn with a new life. -from the Places of Interest 30/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS09-056: The place where a certain Dragon gained immense power upon his reincarnation. From that moment on, this site has become sacred ground for all Dragons. -from the Places of Interest 123/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS09-058: A forbidden tome that holds the many records of the Dark Snakes dating back to ancient times. Its contents are shrouded in mystery, but perhaps an even greater enigma is how the Dark Snakes managed to write any records at all, what with having no arms.... -from the Places of Interest 204/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS09-059: A shrine erected to worship the spirits who created these forests. Actually, one can find many shrines like this spread out in one single forest, resulting in diverse architectural styles. -from the Places of Interest 28/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS09-X35: You're all we can count on!! Please save us! Save this world!!
BS09-X36: The last of the Seven Underworld Generals is actually smaller than imagined, but it soon becomes evident that those who are fooled by his appearance are in for a world of hurt.
BS09-X37: Incredible! He tore off the leader's wings!
BS09-X38: The Invader who vanished from the threshold returns, enveloped in a divine radiance.
BS09-X39: Such overwhelming power... Nothing less expected from the Queen of the Magic Kingdom!
BS10-001: War is spreading through every region of the land like wildfire! Should the Armies of the Sun gain victory, this world shall have everlasting daylight; if the Moon is victorious, this shall become a world of eternal night. Personally, I prefer the world as it is now, with day and night mutually alternating in turn. Well, all the Braves have been inspected and accounted for; now to get back to work! —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS10-003: Their reign over the skies has been completely stolen. And now the Dinosaurs are beginning to sacrifice themselves—apparently fighting in losing battles are becoming more common
BS10-004: 同じく大穴を落下していく魚の背に、必死にしがみついた。 ―放浪者ロロ『異界見聞録』赤の章第13節―
BS10-006: Deep in the heart of the jungle, a stone circle suddenly emerges. There, a brilliantly colored crimson warrior tirelessly guards the premises; his oath sworn by faith does not forgive intrusion by anyone. —from the Tucana chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS10-008: The Impregnable Fortress has turned into a sea of flames, and the defense troops have all been annihilated! I heard that some others caught a glimpse of a giant fire dragon in the skies, but... It couldn't be...! —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS10-009: It's okay to hope, right? The Dragons descending from the skies are winning, right?
BS10-013: The Dark Snakes told me that my existence is similar to that of Demonkin… I don't understand what they meant. -from the 9th paragraph in chapter Purple of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS10-014: Once all seven Underworld Generals were defeated, the systematic counterstrike simply fell apart. This repetition of individual unsuccessful invasions makes me think back to the deeds of the Old Tyrants... Perhaps it's because everyone in this realm has nearly the same mentality. -from the 14th paragraph in chapter Purple of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS10-015: There are many who wish for eternal life. However, if they knew of the destiny that would lie before them—to be revived, only to be killed once again—would they still desire immortality?
BS10-016: The fallen dead that the Demonkin revive shall never die again; what awaits them is total destruction.
BS10-017: The siege of the Infernal Lords buried the Generals of Oblivion, but their moment of victory was quickly erased due to the emergence of more Oblivion troops bearing striking resemblances to the fallen generals...
BS10-018: It is whispered that there are some Old Tyrants who threw away their humanlike forms. The end result is that they bear a terrible curse within.
BS10-019: The battle has already been decided! What's he doing? Is he simply rewinding time just to enjoy once again the slaughter and bloodshed that transpired?! —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS10-020: A bewitching, and rather divine presence. —from the Hydrus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS10-023: Guided by the Birds, I arrived at the top of a hill where a doorway stood. The vast wasteland that spread before my eyes was a heartbreaking sight. The forest was once so fresh and verdant; now I can't feel even a hint of a breath of life anywhere. I wonder if the siblings who served as my guides here are doing alright.... Saving these thoughts in my heart, I left this world behind. -from the 15th paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS10-025: I would prefer the trees that can move to flee instead of fight. Do they not understand that they themselves make the precious forest?
BS10-026: Let's follow this elder to higher ground. We already handed over the sword; now we'll just be in the way of the battle if we stay any longer.
BS10-027: The eyes of a young warrior-in-training views battles as grand festivals. To him, the battlefield is a playground, and the erasing of others' lives becomes the ultimate pastime. —from the Lynx chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS10-028: After running nonstop, I finally collapsed. My throat hurt so much I couldn't breathe properly. Before my eyes was a giant mushroom, but I dared not to bite into it. Lowering my gaze, I spotted a tiny tree sapling growing. There, a fruit seed was growing. -from the 9th paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS10-029: A dangerous charm! An absolute charisma! Even his minor efforts have a great influence on the tide of battle. —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS10-030: The Ants have marched into battle against the evil gods. Apparently they intend to use "strength in numbers" to their advantage.
BS10-032: A bitterness painted with a squirming roar... Even if the Singing Diva Princess who lost her song became completely powerless, she would become a wall and sacrifice everything through devotion, believing that one's life resides in one's own voice.
BS10-033: Whipping out his strong arms, white fur soon becomes dyed in red. <br—from the Ursa Major chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS10-034: The Deity of Oblivion fires a red beam of light; the Singing Diva's shield deflects it away.
BS10-035: Was it just a voice? Or was it a song? The Singing Diva squeezed out one last sound from within her body before crumbling to pieces before my eyes. Her singing voice, the very embodiment of her self-sacrifice, harmonized with the voices of her fellow princesses and resonated throughout the world. As if this song became a worldwide prayer answered, it made the Empty Sky Deity who was destroying everything in sight suddenly stop in its tracks... And that single moment was all the Braver needed. -from the 12th paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS10-036: To him, the great sea and sky are nothing more than mere puddles. Everything in his grasp is his territory. —from the Dorado chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS10-037: There lies a whirlpool of emptiness, sucking things in and spitting things out. One brave soul acts as a plug to stop the vortex. The destruction recedes as the void grows weaker....
BS10-038: A flash of the black spear overwhelms all who have no power; thus, a battlefield only for the strong is born.
BS10-039: I beheld a very unique miracle. The glass goddess shattered to pieces with one last cry, and thousands were swept into the vortex of nothingness... But then the Empty Sky Deity was destroyed along with the Braver. A hefty compensation, but at least the world itself was saved from destruction. -from the 12th paragraph in chapter White of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS10-040: It supports its own army as a cardinal point for aerial attack; its imposing appearance serves as its shield. —from the Cetus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS10-041: The Topaz Kingdoms famed for being easygoing are going to assist the Solar Militia?! It seems this war's importance is common to the world. It looks like they're sending reinforcements, but where are they marching off to? Wait... Isn't that the Table Mountain...? Hey! If you're looking for the battlegrounds, turn about-face and head right! —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS10-042: Something is falling onto my body; startled, I opened my eyes. It took me a few moments to figure out what was going on. It was dirt. I was laying on my side in a hole, being covered with dirt. That's right, I had just died. Someone was kind enough to give me a burial. Wait a minute, hold on... if that's true, then who or what am I? Once again, my mind is wrapped in a chaotic storm of confusion. -from the 13th paragraph in chapter Yellow of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS10-043: The Magic Kingdom has forged an alliance with the Beast Kingdom to combat those guys. If the Trump Kingdom joined in, they'd be the strongest army this side of Otherrealm! Perhaps we should help out towards reaching that union...?
BS10-044: Did you hear? I heard that the Queen of the Fairies is against looking for the Keys! Something about how the world will fall into chaos if we hand the Keys over to the Angels or something... I don't like the Angels myself, but isn't that assuming a bit too much...?
BS10-046: I do have a rival—the Princess of the Magic Kingdom. She's a formidable foe, so it vexes me, but might I request a favor...?
BS10-048: The Great Gates have been opened... The first Angel to fly out of those gates was more wild and rambunctious than I imagined. -from the 14th paragraph in chapter Yellow of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS10-049: Because she's imprisoned, she knows what freedom is. Her desire for release calls forth a pulsating power from within. —from the Andromeda chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS10-050: The legend of the thunder beast who became a divine creature began with the meeting with a certain young lady. -from the 1st paragraph in the final chapter of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS10-053: We had total dominance of the battlefield before me. Therefore, I'd let my guard down. The worst possible news came to me by sunset: a deity from another world completely demolished the Eastern Kingdom.... -from the 13th paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS10-054: The enemy's attack, the Golems' counterstrike—it doesn't matter who attacks who! The town is being smashed to bits in the crossfire!!
BS10-056: Look at this! It's a perfected armor upgrade! It seems the time has come once again for him to show us his heroic figure from when he last won the championships!
BS10-057: According to the testimony of the last remaining survivors of the Eastern Lands, a deity from another realm summoned forth a massive earthquake that split the earth just as people were in hot debate over the recent battles. The latest reports confirm that the epicenter of the quake is moving southwest, with the Southern Country as its next possible target. To have an earthquake as your enemy... I wonder what the heroes gathered in the Middle Kingdom must be thinking as they prepare to engage this force of nature.
BS10-058: That thing's a monster! It gobbled up that robotic knight whole in a matter of seconds! —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS10-059: Unfortunately, the Grand Tournament has been cancelled indefinitely until further notice. The building that was supposed to serve as the main arena for the event is now battling right in front of my eyes. For the future of the Tournament and the world, I can only pray that the arena does not get destroyed. -from the 9th paragraph in chapter Blue of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS10-060: He is a grizzled war veteran. When he enters the battlefield, "destruction" is far too simple a word to describe the outcome. —from the Orion chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS10-062: A streak of hellfire that cuts through the darkness and silence of the starry skies —- a true Brave of flames. —from the Phoenix chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS10-063: As I visited the castle, the spear was aimed straight at me. —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS10-064: Just as I thought, the Braves play a major role in the flow of battle. —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS10-065: Every once in a while it gets scary when I'm lost, but I end up running into these guys... —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS10-066: To him, life is but stardust in the night sky. —from the Draco chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS10-067: It fuses at raging speeds, enough to raise dust clouds! —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS10-068: There are even Braves who protect the forest. —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS10-069: Its bladed wings stir up a violent storm. —from the Grus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS10-070: An indomitable knight. Brave and be infused with a will of iron! —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS10-072: His top speed cannot be traced by the naked eye. —from the Piscis Austrinus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS10-074: Gah~... It's just too cute... —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS10-075: A young girl Brave?! Th-that's a first! —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS10-076: If he's a friend, then of course you can trust him! —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS10-077: One can obtain all sorts of power through Brave Fusing. —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS10-078: Try not to get eaten before Braving... —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS10-079: This place is imbued with godlike power. Mysteriously, battles never occur here. —from the Mensa chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS10-080: Power is gathered from the far reaches of the Void, and thus the enigmatic lifeforms known as Spirits are born. In the place where I encountered Spirits being born, there lay a giant, beautiful stone. Anyone can bear witness to this miraculous moment if one is lucky enough. -from the Places of Interest 33/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS10-082: This apparatus measures everything with pinpoint accuracy. The distance to the stars, the hairs on a rat... Some even say it can determine the length of your lifespan. —from the Sextans chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS10-083: This is the old battlefield where the Sixth of the SevenShoguns defeated the last bigshot of the Old Tyrants; it is also where said Shogun was promptly buried by the Empty Sky Deity. -from the Places of Interest 140/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS10-084: This place is the source of the Dark Snakes' knowledge. Apparently they can hear voices whispering to them in this area... It was only then did I realize that the Dark Snakes are not omniscient. -from the Places of Interest 514/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS10-086: A vast range of giant trees used for viewing over very far distances. I tried climbing one of these once, but when the Empty Sky Deity descended, by consequence I was blown off... How regrettable. -from the Places of Interest 810/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS10-087: On the wargrounds where countless brave souls have fallen, can something new be born from the hefty price of life? If you push away a little of the earth on the wargrounds, permeating with the lives and dreams of the fallen, a future filled with hope, down to the smallest leaf vein, surely is growing at rapid speed. At least, this is what I believe. And I have no doubts that the wishes of those who died in battle are the same as mine. Put your ear to the earth... Can't you hear it? The beating pulse of a new future? —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS10-088: This is the castle where a cousin of the Singing Diva once resided. A maestra of the musical arts, the last of the Singing Diva's greatest musicians now spreads her expertise around the world. -from the Places of Interest 606/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS10-089: A lake frozen over due to the Invaders' intrusion, where the primeval power of the origin of life meets a panorama on par with a legendary artist's masterpiece. It may be an imprudent thought on my part, but this place truly is beautiful. -from the Places of Interest 165/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS10-090: Perhaps this is the homestead of the Flying Fish? It's hard not to imagine that to them the great skies are their 'great oceans.' But the fact that the coral itself also has the same sentiment comes to me as a surprise. -from the Places of Interest 56/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS10-091: My hometown was known for having ugly, smelly bubbles made by crabs float into the city from the surface of the nearby lake. To think that such a cute scene as this place would make me think back to where I was born... Maybe it's because I've realized I can't go back home. -from the Places of Interest 27/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS10-092: This flower garden actually changes, showing a different face between day and night. Personally, I prefer the night version. -from the Places of Interest 507/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS10-093:
As the clock's hands calmly draw their arcs, its swaying pendulums release a sweet scent into the winds
.—from the Horologium chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS10-094: It surges forward towards completion as it advances to the future. In other words, it's returning to the past by regaining its ancient form. —from the Carina chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS10-095: This is the battle arena where contests of speed take place. Yet even though the main focus is speed, how come competitions of muscle and power also occur here? Perhaps it's just part of this Gem Realm's tradition." -from the Places of Interest 92/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS10-096: Together with great glory, the Master Unicorn awards this flag to the champion as proof of victory. It has traversed through every tournament in the Sapphire Realm, given only to the finest competitors. ...Or at least, that's how it would have been before the tournaments got cancelled and suspended until further notice. I would love to get my hands on such a legendary trophy, but its great size may pose a problem for me... -from the Places of Interest 259/1000 of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS10-114: Was it a river of tears filled with sorrow, or was it a river of ambitions swirling with plot and strategy? It soon became a raging stream that swallowed up everything in its wake." ——Astral Scholar Lyria, Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights, the Eridanus Chronicles
BS10-X01: Able to destroy both the Sun and the Moon, he is the strongest Astral Deity and the most sinister. —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS10-X02: What beautifully radiates from inside him are stolen lives. —from the Pisces chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS10-X03: For those who battle him, there is no "second time." —from the Cancer chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS10-X04: The air fills with terror... The Incarnation of the Moon has arrived! —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS10-X05: This grotesque soul was once the lovely DragonDeity of Venus. —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS10-X06: His very existence is like... a deadly poison. —from the Scorpio chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS11-001: Covering your ears from the roar of thunder, you can't see a thing through the heavy downpour of rain. As you lose sense of direction — and virtually all other senses in general - lightning flashes but for a split second; the only way you can move forward is to glimpse at your surroundings under the brief light and devote the rest to memory... This is the violent world that lies within the Oort Dragon's Nest. Since the Sun Dragon has encamped himself here, this hellish environment shall soon become the next stage for battle; the Lunar Brigade has sent all of its aerial combat forces to Oort, certainly to go after the Sun Dragon's head. The Battle of Oort is about to begin! —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS11-002: I have traversed through all six Gem Realms and witnessed the total destruction of four of them. This realm, too, is reaching its final days. The Dragons have transformed themselves into innumerable stars as they cascade upon the land. The world will be grievously wounded, but when facing the forces of Empty Sky, there's no other option. -from the first paragraph in the final chapter of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS11-003: From the skies, he soars to distant lands in search of food. All who are reflected in the sharp glint of his eyes quickly become his prey. —from the Aquila chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS11-004: Looking from a distance, the Oort Dragon's Nest looks like a giant hourglass. Something sprinkles and falls from its center. As I turned my gaze downwards, I gasped; falling into a massive pile were the bodies of Lunar Brigade troops, all in miserable condition... —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS11-006: If you make light of the fact he's just a child, expect to be sent to the afterlife in the next few seconds. He has had a heightened sense of battle since the day he was born. Truly, this child is a rare gem blessed with his ability and intelligence. —from the Leo Minor chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS11-008: The Empty Sky Deity was destroyed, ambushed by the Ancient Dragons. But it was still too late... -from the 1st paragraph of the final chapter of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS11-009: The earth lightly trembles, when suddenly—BOOM!!! An explosive thud resounds with enough force to rock the planet to its core. Following the impact is an enraged roar loud enough to shatter your eardrums! The 'Black Supernova' has risen... In the final stages of the Great Wall of the Shield invasion, the armies of the Solar Militia fell to pieces in a devastating burst. —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS11-010: "I cannot die. But how would I fare among the Demonkin? They create zombies and enslave the living dead. I once had interest in the World Tree's power, but I dare not try it out for myself." -from the 3rd paragraph in chapter Purple of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS11-011: A stench that pierces the nose; a corpse-like figure that makes you want to look away... It may be hard to believe, but battlegrounds whose flames have died become mountainous feasts for this creature. To use more refined terms, his vulgar job would be called "aftermath management." —from the Musca chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS11-013: Whoever determined that dogs are the definition of loyalty? I already understood this Spirit's instincts as soon as I laid eyes on it; the only thing this creature is loyal to is its own desires. Of course, it's most likely impossible to classify this Spirit as a dog... —from the Canes Venatici chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS11-014: "Assured total defeat, an honorable death... This is the path the noblemen of old chose." -from the 14th paragraph in chapter Purple of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS11-015: It is said that wherever this beast visits becomes a living hell. If what witnesses say is true, then hell on our world has only just begun. —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS11-016: The Mansion of Darkness managed to endure even a devastating attack from the gods, but the enemy still succeeded in invading the premises. The air trembles with the command of the mansion's master... -from the 14th paragraph in chapter Purple of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS11-017: It seems that the Three Astral Kings, who suddenly appeared in the skies above the Aquapolis, are going after the Eight Astral Dragons. As for my motives... I can't write that yet; I can't afford to risk my plans being spoiled by anyone who glances at this memo. —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS11-019: With strange long ears blowing in the wind, it acutely senses danger and jumps to the battlefield. Catching sight of its cute form during the extreme atrocities of wartime is the ultimate healing. —from the Hare chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS11-020: It is said the onmyoji of the Great Tree's forest has divinated the end result of this war. But it turns out that after his ritual, he couldn't see anything. Could this be a sign that the world's end is near? Or is it simply a conclusion that no one can predict...? —A memo from Negotiator Mix—
BS11-021: A bird whose color is nothing like anything seen in this world and a chirp ever so mysterious. Is it just a dream? Or can this creature be real? It's like gazing upon the ultimate mirage. —from the Apus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS11-024: The faint mist surrounding the forest completely cleared, at the same time as I put the fruit in my mouth. That seems to have been the sign of the final battle. Truly the last. -from the 9th paragraph in chapter Green of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
