BS33-024: "I have been enthralled by Lord Yaibanokami and will follow him anywhere!"
BS33-025: The three vassals Ratel, Yukinojou, and Higumaru were originally assassins turned against Yaibanokami.
BS33-026: Yaibanokami's three retainers were once part of an elite Ninja Gale squad. They made a name for themselves as distinguished mercenaries who sniffed out battles.
BS33-027: The daimyo of Verdant Leaf Province, Yaibanokami, was a humble yet tenacious general with a strong sense of honor. In the Battle of Nagashino, he repayed the favor of Tensei helping him in a previous war by assisting the Heaven Squad.
BS33-028: As the few soldiers guarding Nagashino Castle were low on provisions and morale, it was believed that the reinforcements of Heaven sieging the castle would soon topple it.
BS33-029: "Each time my beauteous voice rings forth, a thousand riches and a hundred lives are born."
BS33-030: The letter from the reinforcements only read "endure for three days."
BS33-031: The Six Heaven Army assigned Senryuukaku to Nagashino Castle's defense, and Onmyou Territory covertly sent Mudou to the military castle for an ambush.
BS33-032: The Master took advantage of the Battle of Nagashino and was ready to deal a decisive blow to the Heaven Militia. Not only did he bring in the superior SengokuSixGeneral, Senryuukaku of Clever Machine Province, but he also put in a request for another skilled SengokuSixGeneral, Mudou of Violet Spectre Province, to join the reinforcements. From this, we can grasp his extraordinary ardor.
BS33-033: The plan to lure them to the military castle succeeded thanks to Shouen's provocation.
BS33-034: The generals clad in a golden aura were dubbed the SengokuSixGenerals. That aura gave them divine protection, and no ordinary attack could come close to them.
BS33-035: The SengokuSixGenerals were all powerful generals strong enough to best a thousand warriors. The reason for their power lay in their secret techniques.
BS33-036: Senryuukaku was the Master's trump card in the Battle of Nagashino.
BS33-037: After the Six Heaven Army arrived at Nagashino Castle, they fortified the military castle in a single day to intercept the Heaven Squad. ―from the Battle of Nagashino Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―
BS33-038: "Three days! Keep them at bay, even if you must exhaust the shells and provisions!"
BS33-039: The Master was perfectly prepared for the Battle of Nagashino, and had readied backup plans. He was careful to not allow any miscalculations and made his challenge.
BS33-040: "Now that ten thousand troops and a fortified castle have been prepared, we shall not be disgraced by the flag of Heaven."
BS33-041: "What is this... Whatever, I'll take a nap♪" ―22nd in Line to Inherit the Throne, Tanpopo―
BS33-043: "Tanpopo-san~ would you like some tea? Oh my~ there's something on your sleeve~" ―14th in Line to Inherit the Throne, Nadeshiko―
BS33-044: While searching for Kashaneko, Bakelkatze found the fleeing Heaven army. The War Dragons evaded annihilation and were invited to the Youkai Folk's hidden village.
BS33-046: "There are 22 in line to inherit the throne... for those like me who would be higher if counting down, the matter is wholly irrelevant." ―19th in Line to Inherit the Throne, Mikage―
BS33-047: After the Battle of Oukehazama, Kashaneko disappeared without a word to his vassals. Setodaishou covered for his absence and kept the Youkai Folk together.
BS33-048: "There's a fairy tale that says there was once a hero in this land who took a princess with the same name as mine as his wife and revived the country. Do you believe it?" ―8th in Line to Inherit the Throne, Kei―
BS33-049: "The fragments of my soul are a stimulant that gives the dying the energy of a hundred soldiers."
BS33-050: "Lord Bakelkatze, should we welcome the outsiders into the hidden village?"
BS33-051: The Azure Fang Squad was a warlike clan of Blue Seas Province mainly formed of Beast Heads. They were a group of ruffians, but their ship-steering and finesse at waterfront battles was peerless. The SengokuSixGeneral Tidal-Blue was well-known as their main asset.
BS33-052: Receiving intel that the Six Heaven Army's reinforcements were heading toward the besieged Nagashino Castle, the Azure Fang Squad sent a messenger to the Heaven Squad.
BS33-053: "We can't fall behind the War Dragons! Charge!"
BS33-054: In preparation for their skirmish with the Six Heaven Army, the Heaven Squad requested to form an alliance with the Azure Fang Squad.
BS33-055: The Azure Fang Squad was a ragged band of outlaws that repeatedly committed acts of pillage and destruction. They had a plan to build connections with other provinces and bring down Gandala. ―from the Soldier's Biography of "Sengoku Obscurities" by Kuroe―
BS33-056: Tidal-Blue shouted at the Azure Fang Squad cowering at the Clever Machine warship, destroyed the military castle with one stroke of his sword, and opened the way for the charge.
BS33-057: "The Six Heaven Army's military castle? Demolish it outright!!"
BS33-058: "The Azure Fang Squad has escaped the notice of Gandala and has stuck its head into another province's war... I must inform Lord Senju of this."
BS33-059: The Yaibanokami Army kept fighting until the very end, even after the Azure Fang Squad withdrew. After they saw the retreat of Heaven, Yaibanokami, having honored his duty to Tensei, disappeared with his three vassals as a whirlwind suddenly swept through the battlefield.
BS33-060: Did it fall from the sky? A massive book is clogging up the caldera. This raises numerous questions, but there's no way to confirm them. ―Soul Spot 43/47―
BS33-061: Combat Era year 674. With the exile of the 15th Shogun, the Six Shogunate collapsed. ―from the Six Shogunate Collapse Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―
BS33-062: Though the road regularly splits on a journey, this choice is particularly difficult. Will ogres or snakes come?... If you choose the wrong path, you're dead. ―Soul Spot 21/47―
BS33-063: The stronghold of Onmyou Territory lay in the area of Violet Spectre Province that was inhabited by the Nightlings. Violet Spectre Province was an appropriate place for sorcery, as it bordered on the lands of the living and the dead.
BS33-064: A beautiful castle that suddenly reveals itself in the forest. Surrounded by plants, there's no visible entrance to the inside. ―Soul Spot 12/47―
BS33-065: Ratel's company, hired by the Six Heaven Army for assassination, was instead persuaded by Yaibanokami and became his subordinates. ―from the Soldier's Biography of "Sengoku Obscurities" by Kuroe―
BS33-066: A tidal flat is intended to protect the soil and provide nourishment for ocean life. This particular one even furnishes energy. ―Soul Spot 15/47―
BS33-067: In the far away skies, Senryuukaku's slash that mowed down the first corps to set foot on the military castle came from the Clever Machine warship hidden by cloud cover.
BS33-068: Should this really be called a river? It's a bizarre stream that raises an insatiable appetite with its mysterious smell. ―Soul Spot 37/47―
BS33-069: The Great Sengoku Era had extraordinary generals known as the SengokuSixGenerals. What they had in common were their historically significant actions and their overwhelming might.
BS33-070: A blue forest with a mysterious atmosphere. It's not clear whether the statues that stand at its entrance are welcoming or warning the visitor... ―Soul Spot 2/47―
BS33-071: The leader of the Azure Fang Squad, Tidal-Blue was a brave commander who was counted as one of the SengokuSixGenerals. It was impossible for an ordinary defending army to stop his offensive maneuvers.
BS33-CP01: The one standing in the way of Kei and I is our greatest enemy!!
BS33-CP02: I dislike that there are so many Spirits in the Yellow Region who are inconsistent with the data. Like Asia or this Angelia... I don't know why her nickname is "Reset".
BS33-X01: "The Twin Heaven United secret sword unleashed through 'Flame Bolt' and 'Shooting Star'! Infinite Blade!!"
BS33-X02: "My lightning-speed lance pierces a hundred soldiers with one thrust, and destroys the country with the second."
BS33-X04: "My Secret Technique is a silver slash that sunders the earth and freezes time itself."
BS33-X05: "Come on down, it's a festival! Let's make the red, white, and yellow flowers bloom!!" ―5th in Line to Inherit the Throne, Mikoto―
BS33-X06: "My blade fells the enemy commander on the first strike, and crushes the rebellious hearts upon the return stroke."
BS33-XX01: Power, that is to say, truth.
BS33-XX02: Putting an end to chaos, and restoring the world to silence.
BS34-002: Gyuumonji did not return to Flame War Province, and the Supreme Beast Army that governed the Emperor Beasts lost its commander. It was at this time that the SengokuSixGeneral Leonlancer began his rise to power.
BS34-003: Burning-Souldragon heard God-Sechs' secret from the messenger that returned from Clever Machine Province and formed a strategy to defeat Six Heaven's Rush.
BS34-004: Combat Era, October 600. What would become the last and greatest war of the Great Sengoku Era, the Battle of Senkigahara, had begun. ―from the Senkigahara Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―
BS34-005: "Whether Six Heaven's Rush can be eradicated or not depends on the actions of each of the six provinces."
BS34-006: "God-Sechs must be destroyed by the commander of Flame War..."
BS34-008: Taking advantage of Clever Machine Province's rivalry between factions, the forces supporting the Six Heaven Army lingered in their own provinces. ―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Sheba―
BS34-009: "A SengokuSixGeneral, hm... good grief, this will take some effort."
BS34-010: Rather than summon several thousand paltry soldiers in preparation for battle, Rikudou instead chose to summon only the best two Ogre Wizards, Front Ogre and Back Ogre.
BS34-011: The Nightlings that controlled Onmyou Territory brought the Ogre Wizards with them to the Six Heaven Army faction. The only ones from Violet Spectre Province that sided with the GenjiEightKnights faction were really the Spiritual Beasts. Of course, their only reason was probably just that they didn't like the Six Heaven Army. ―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Sheba―
BS34-012: The Master believed strongly in the Six Absolute Deities. After the Six Heaven Army invaded each province, he would investigate the ruins there and collect monuments and ritual tools. ―from the Soldier's Biography of "Sengoku Obscurities" by Kuroe―
BS34-013: While there are existing historical documents that state the Master died in the Incident at Bonnouji, some archives claim that he appeared during the Battle of Senkigahara. Though they seem to contradict each other at first glance, both are likely true. ―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Sheba―
BS34-014: Darkness-Griffon planned to return the Master from the underworld. And so he awaited for the moment when the largest war began. ―from the Soldier's Biography of "Sengoku Obscurities" by Kuroe―
BS34-015: In preparation for war, the high-ranking Nightlings of Onmyou Territory convened at the depths of the underworld. They summoned a multitude of powerful Ogre Wizard warriors at the ancient shrine there.
BS34-016: The Master took Greedy-Death-Gal-Vados, one of the pillars of the Six Absolute Deities believed to live in Violet Spectre Province's underworld, very seriously.
BS34-017: "To connect Senkigahara and the underworld... it is not impossible, however..."
BS34-018: In a strange turn, the general of the Spiritual Beasts, Amehoshi-no-Mikoto, sealed away Onmyou Territory's army and opened the warpath for Burning-Souldragon.
BS34-020: The stage for the war was Senkigahara, a lordless and desolate wasteland.
BS34-021: A total of over 16000 troops from both sides met at Senkigahara. ―from the Senkigahara Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―
BS34-022: The confrontation between Ninja Gale and the Yaibanokami Army. Their strength in warfare was a close match, but Yaibanokami had more experience as a leader. Otonosama, who had been engaged by Ninja Gale on short notice, was quickly defeated.
BS34-023: All so Burning-Souldragon could end the fight with a one-hit finisher, the generals of all provinces that approved of destroying Six Heaven's Rush worked together.
BS34-025: Having fought together with Amatsu in the Battle of Nagashino, Yaibanokami did not betray that loyalty in the Battle of Senkigahara.
BS34-026: "Damn you, accursed Yaibanokami, just you wait... I shall show you what I can do in this war!"
BS34-027: Otonosama had lost the power struggle for Verdant Leaf Province and decided to side with the Six Heaven Army faction, which employed the services of Ninja Gale Village. Senkigahara was the spot where power struggles for many provinces took place. ―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Sheba―
BS34-028: The one chosen for this battle by the Village is a StrangeFangShinobi who excels in armed combat.
BS34-029: "No matter how hard a defense you mount, there are sure to be gaps that shinobi can sneak in."
BS34-031: The GenjiEightKnights were a veteran group of fighters that existed since before the Great Sengoku Era. Tycoon governed the province by cooperating with the well-liked GenjiEightKnights.
BS34-032: Could God-Sechs have awaited for a war where every general from the Six Provinces gathered in order to better exploit them with the Six Heaven's Rush technique?
BS34-033: Combat Era Year 598. The lord of Clever Machine Province, Tycoon, ceases functioning.
BS34-034: When God-Sechs appeared, a messenger flew straight towards Clever Machine Province by Burning-Souldragon's order for the sake of releasing Daybreak-Third from the underground prison of the Six Heaven Castle.
BS34-035: The Battle of Senkigahara was, in a way, a battle to destroy Six Heaven's Rush. The key to destroy Six Heaven's Rush is to defeat God-Sechs' army. In other words, fate rested upon each of the Six Provinces' battles.
BS34-036: "What's necessary for Six Heaven's Rush are spirits from each of the Six Provinces. The more spirits that are offered to it, the stronger its power becomes."
BS34-037: Several days after the Incident at Bonnouji, the Clever Machine squadron that caused the uprising was captured by Tycoon and imprisoned in the Six Heaven Castle's dungeon.
BS34-038: "It is hard to believe that the Master perished in the case of Bonnouji, but..."
BS34-039: "The GenjiEightKnights shall dispose of the Clever Machine ruffians."
BS34-040: "Hey, Mizuki, the two of us should go out together sometimes!" ―16th in Line to Inherit the Throne, Tamaki―
BS34-041: The Youkai Folk collaborated with armies from other provinces and aided in the battle against God-Sechs. That being said, they had the same goals: to release their comrades and destroy Six Heaven's Rush.
BS34-042: The Six Heavens' Army raids the Youkai Folk's Hidden Village, those who fail to escape are captured.
BS34-043: "Forget about the war for a while, let your wings rest..." ―7th in Line to Inherit the Throne, Kochou―
BS34-044: "If we can take our comrades back, the War Dragons will likely be able to take care of the rest."
BS34-045: After the war, the lost Throne Inheritance ticket was found in the Youkai Folk Village. The lot's result was...
BS34-046: "Sara, your face is very pretty ☆" "Oh my, sister Kira, you too have a beautiful face ★" ―10th & 11th in Line to Inherit the Throne, Kira & Sara―
BS34-047: Don Nurarihyon, an elder of the Youkai Folk, called together Youkai lurking in every land to the hidden village.
BS34-048: The Six Heaven Army's raid naturally provoked the rage of the Youkai Folk. To take back the captured Youkai, the Youkai Folk unified and joined the war.
BS34-049: Azure Fang Squad has, obviously, allied with the campaign that's opposite to Gandala's. This is the my enemy's enemy is my ally thing, isn't it? ―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Sheba―
BS34-050: Could the historical records of the Battle of Senkigahara having ambiguous descriptions regarding God-Sechs be because the spirits absorbed by Six Heavens' Rush couldn't remember anything? ―Margin scrawls from "Research Observations" by Sheba―
BS34-052: The figure of God-Sechs which came forth from a burning ship had undergone a great transfiguration from the figure God-Sechs had previous to the Bonnouji Incident.
BS34-053: At Senkigahara, the opposing forces of each country faced each other. This means that Gandala was pushed towards a confrontation against the Azure Fang Squad.
BS34-054: The one leading the Azure Fang Squad during this war was the Beast Head warrior, Shironagasu.
BS34-055: The Six Heaven Army faction desired war, making all of Gandala's mediation in vain.
BS34-056: The battle between Gandala's Senju and Azure Fang Squad's Shironagasu was violent and splendid to an earth-gouging extent.
BS34-057: "If Six Heaven's Rush isn't dispelled first, there's no way to win."
BS34-058: The brethren sword of Onimaru, one of the Five Dominance Swords, forged by the same craftsman.
BS34-059: The armor that the Azure Fang Squad wears is an exceptional item that is thin and lightweight enough for aquatic battles. However, as it is so light, it is dangerous for those who have not trained to brave with it for underwater fights.
BS34-060: A majestic mountain range floating in the sky dyed red as blood. On first sight, one might feel as if heaven and earth have been flipped around. ―Soul Spot 20/47―
BS34-061: Flame War Province achieved revenge for the Battle of Nagashino and crushed God-Sechs' ambition.
BS34-062: There is said to be a tree in a vast skyscraper that bears the fruit of knowledge. Those brave enough to taste it may as well try to find it. ―Soul Spot 23/47―
BS34-063: History books do not tell the full truth, only the historical truth. ―Margin Scrawls from "Research Observations" by Shiva―
BS34-064: A herd of male horses gallop through the mountain pass. They continue to run in hopes of finding a new plain. ―Soul Spot 10/47―
BS34-065: The Battle of Senkigahara came to a close with a victory for the GenjiEightKnights faction. ―from the Battle of Senkigahara Scroll of "Sengoku Authentic Legend" by Enji―
BS34-068: The flowers blooming on the trees are fragrant, allowing one to appreciate the charming scenery. Although the poems the Pentan recites don't make sense. ―Soul Spot 30/47―
BS34-069: The Gandala generals gathered at the Temple Fortress and started the Wisdom King Meeting. Their discussion topic was to which of the two factions that Clever Machine Province had split into they should ally with.
BS34-070: A cave which suddenly opened its mouth on an empty grassland. I can understand being interested, but entry is forbidden. ―Soul Spot 35/47―
BS34-071: Thanks to the Six Heaven Rush, the air above the battleground of Senkigahara was stagnant and the entire surroundings was engulfed in a bizarre space.
BS34-CP01: The guardian that watches over the Flame War Province from the caldera of the country. "Dance, O Flame! The Ring of Flames Formation passed down from every generation of War Dragons shall not perish!"
BS34-CP02: The guardian that watches over the Violet Spectre Province from the faint haze of the country. "Intruders that hide in the darkness...Let's welcome them, shall we?"
BS34-CP03: The guardian that watches over the Verdant Leaf Province from the forest of the country. "Knowing nothing about ninja arts, but stepping into the forest of the village. That's some good guts."
BS34-CP04: The guardian that watches over the Clever Machine Province from the fortress of the country. "WARNING...TRESPASSERS WITHOUT PERMIT...WOULD BE BOMBARDED BY NUMEROUS FORTS"
BS34-CP05: The guardian that watches over the Flowering Yellow Province from the garden of the country. "To those scoundrels who interrupt the silence of moon night, punishment is needed..."
BS34-CP06: The guardian that watches over the Blue Seas Province from the coast of the country. "Pointing your blades at us, is like trying to fight against the raging high tides!"
BS34-CP07: ""My lance is a fearsome flame that scorches the resisting masses!!"
BS34-X01: "I shall end the lengthy war here and now...!"
BS34-X02: "Souls called from the underworld are nothing but temporary things, after all."
BS34-X03: The most pro-war member of Ninja Gale Village, skilled with all kinds of armor.
BS34-X04: "The technique must be eradicated and Six Heaven destroyed."
BS34-X05: "The lineage is just for show, it doesn't really matter. Hey, don't you think so?" ―3rd in Line to Inherit the Throne, Ayame―
BS34-X06: "Compared to the raging waves of the sea during a storm, a thousand troops are easy to overcome."
BS34-XX01: The hero who saved the Six Provinces sublimated into the War God that watches over the Six Provinces.
BS34-XX02: "All ye common soldiers, be sacrificed to my Six Heaven's Rush!!"
BS35-001: The opening battle of the 216th BSGP will be held in a land enclosed by steep mountains as if shutting out visitors. It's the land of snow and ice, North-Trio.
BS35-002: The pole position on the opening battle is racer King Cheetah. Thanks to a combination of terrain and climate, he ran as well as the audience predicted.
BS35-003: In the past, the famous "Team Dragonia" kept turning out Dragon God-Kings. But recently they've been slumping, and the Dragon God-King title has been taken by many "Team Turon" members. This year, they're looking to reclaim the Dragon God-King.
BS35-004: The leading racers are Sylpheed-Husky, Mistral-Bit, and Exeseed, and at a short distance from them, the second group undauntedly follows after!
BS35-005: Here we go, the race has just started, but the rivals are already going at it! Racers Salablade and Blazoma won't give in! What do we have here, Racer Salablade's blow has made Racer Blazoma fall back?!
BS35-006: Racer Seiga came all the way from overseas. His dream is to return home triumphantly, or something. As Japang would also be holding a part of this tournament, I hope he can do his best.
BS35-007: Racer Execeed lost to Racer Gale-Phoenix by one beak's length. Maan, was that a climactic God-King vs God-King battle!
BS35-008: Racer Heaven is a member of "Team Dragonia", but incredibly enough, his grandfather seems to have been a general in Japang.
BS35-009: Racer Exeseed's heat melts the snow in front of him and clears a path to the goal!
BS35-010: Jura & Dyna is famous for being the oldest BSGP team. As the current course is a cold land, it's quite disadvantageous for them.
BS35-011: Here he comes! Dodging Racer Calamity Boar's crash, Salablade, who boasts Felarl Racing's number one legs, has arrived! Following after Racer Exeseed, will it be a one-two finish?!
BS35-012: Information about the big crash has come in. It seems that this time, the cause was Racer Ourovorius' attack. The site is still covered in black smoke, so we can't ascertain the situation. Since a considerable amount of racers have retired, there is concern for their safety. Tonio is currently heading to the site, so let's wait for a follow-up.
BS35-013: The last spurt is developing into a three-way struggle! Now, on whose head will the crown of victory shine on for BSGP's opening battle, the Norse-Trio GP?!
BS35-014: "I got the info about the Imajin. I couldn't let them monopolize something this useful."
BS35-015: The Imajin that Ourovorius brought braves with Amethyst-Dragon. Irregularities aside, I'm thankful for being able to obtain actual battle data. The results were above expectations, but regarding making their existence public, we can only wait for the higher-ups' decision. ―■■■ Report―
BS35-016: Awaiting the racers in the middle of the race who made it through the treacherous mountain path is a course through the forest with lots of curves that make it impossible to see ahead.
BS35-017: Oooh! I couldn't see it very well from over here, but it seems there was a mysterious attack from Racer Ourovorius in the back!
BS35-018: Racer Glaizus is running while pulling Racers Ourovorius and Amethyst-Dragon behind him. It seems Turon's cooperation is going well.
BS35-019: The big explosion that happened mid-race seemed to have gotten Racer Amethyst-Dragon. However, that crisis is surpassed and he returns to the race. Afterwards, with a smooth pace, he successfully enters the rankings.
BS35-020: After the attack, Ourovorius stalls, then goes to the rear of the second group as if watching the situation!
BS35-021: Evidently, this explosion was caused by a gigantic dragon. That's all; this is Tonio, reporting on site.
BS35-022: The Mad Scientist welcomed by the "Diabolics". What sort of ripples will the secret technique from the eastern island country make on BSGP?!
BS35-023: This time, I'm entering Fordelia Wings' garage. Birds, birds, birds, birds everywhere; as to be expected from the rulers of the sky. Now then, how well is Fordelia Wings doing this year? Ah, let's ask that crew member with the impressive eyebrows. Yes, yes, I see... Contestant Gale-Phoenix's wing repair is going smoothly. Fordelia was lamenting the rough weather last year, but it looks like they're out to show some improvements this year!
BS35-024: The BSGP is a celebration that happens once every twelve years. So, contestants from all over the world come to make a name for themselves there. Racer Tashigi is one of them, a ninja from a small eastern island country!
BS35-025: A fierce wind is raging right above the competitors in the opening mountain area, and the racers of Fordelia Wings are having a tough time!
BS35-026: The endgame course of the Norse-Trio GP is a complete 180 from the poor visibility of the forest course, and is instead a prairie bare as the eye can see. The snow's piled on thick, so it's sure to trip up the contestants.
BS35-027: The first challenge to stand in front of the racers is a cold mountain course. The one who flies into the lead is Racer Sylpheed Husky! "Beast Tribe" also has a Racer specialized in cold lands!
BS35-028: "I am a descendant from the clan which was chased away from Ninja Gale Village. In this BSGP, I hope to cleanse the dirtied name of my ancestors."
BS35-029: "Fordelia Wings" is a team that aims for the title of Rooster Sexagenary God. At the pit, they care for each and every feather without missing a single one.
BS35-030: The racers from the second group which had to drop out due to to Racer Ourovorius' attack seem to be receiving first aids from the Team's crew.
BS35-031: Gale-Phoenix has the greatest supporters with him. They're Racer Euros-Falcon and Racer Van-Eagle. If these three birds are in formation, they won't lose no matter how the wind blows!
BS35-032: Racer Gale-Phoenix, who was plagued by the cruel weather of the mountainous area, makes miraculous gains by the middle of the race and pokes at the back of the leading group!
BS35-033: The mountain weather that was a big wall at the start of the race, now has turned into the tailwind of victory and pushes up Racer Gale-Phoenix! Racer Salablade is surpassed, Dos-Deimos is flied above, ouch, Racer King Cheetah retreats due to the wind! Only Racer Exeseed remaaaaains!
BS35-034: "Scuderia Maclarn" is a team formed of Machine Beasts and Androids. Their specialty is setting themselves up to fit the course and calibrating themselves fully for it. Their stout pace and high completion ratio tells a lot about how precise they are. This time, Racer Glorious-Sheep is also undergoing enhancement remodeling, and it looks like they're planning to make their victory at BSGP a certainty.
BS35-035: "Scuderia Maclarn" has been building up a steady race, but the keystone figure, Glorious-Sheep, can't be seen anywhere. Racer Ourovorias' blow has been sending one after another into retiring, but could it be that Glorious-Sheep got caught up in that?
BS35-036: As expected, the team that's strong on a cold land is this one, "Scuderia Maclarn". Their pit crew is perfectly equipped to handle blizzards, it seems.
BS35-037: Aaah, it's Racer Glorious-Sheep! A miraculous survival from that explosion! That beautiful body hasn't suffered a single wound! As expected of one called the God-King of Protection. All that remains is catching up to the leading group! A chance still remains!
BS35-038: It's Racer Ibericsen from the second group! He gave a comment before the race: "I'm used to snow roads." Oooh, isn't he cool?
BS35-039: Racer Ibericsen brings out his transformation specialty and tows his team!
BS35-040: "Scuderia Maclarn", the team that never bends to any impeding attacks, easily passes by racer Ourovorius' attack and nibbles at the heels of the leading group!
BS35-041: "My ambition won't come to an end just with a small island country! It's the world! What I'll take on my hands is the entire world!"
BS35-042: As the audience predicted, "Scuderia Maclarn" has done well in all areas, but only a little more of the race remains! Now, once they climb this last hill, the goal will come into sight! Will Racer King Cheetah catch up to Racer Dos-Deimos in front of him!?
BS35-043: "After that country-splitting great decisive war, peace reigned over my province! I'll leave the rest to my machine successors and fulfill my one and only lament!"
BS35-044: Following after Dos-Deimos, King Cheetah also reaches the goal! A reliable teamwork bore its fruits.
BS35-045: "Fruits Kingdom" is a team centered around Fruitsels. Previously they participated as the participating racers' alimentation, but now they're participating as racers. I'm already looking forward to what sort of racing they will do.
BS35-046: It seems to be a racer from "Fruits Kingdom", let's try an interview. This child is a... chestnut? Apparently it is. No, hmmm? Ah, ouch! Don't throw these thorns! It huuurts!
BS35-047: Whoa, Racer Ringostarr, as if running away from Racer Patissiere behind him, fiercely dashes! No, this could actually be running away, maybe. It'd be good if he continued in this fashion until reaching the goal.
BS35-048: BSGP's opening battle already has had up to ninth place decided. As point awarding occurs, which racer will become tenth place? Oh, that blazing mane is Racer Blazoma! And now, gooooaaaal! But, wait, there's someone holding onto the horn, isn't there? Whoa, it's Racer Rickey-Mouchuu!! Tenth place was the Rat God-King, Rickey-Mouchuu!
BS35-049: I've spotted Racer Kidracula of "Ghost Riders"! Would you let this lady listen to your story? Ah, he disappeared.
BS35-050: "Fruits Kingdom"'s pit has a niiice aroma. They're an unknown team due to being first participants, but as far as supplies go, they're perfect!
BS35-051: Midrace, the racers are readjusting their equipment at their Pits. Huh? The "Fruits Kingdom" Racers seem to be calmly enjoying an afternoon nap.
BS35-052: The "Fruits Kingdom" racers are hampered by the rigorous course and fall out one after the other. Amid such situation, however, Racer Suikadon continues running composedly.
BS35-053: "The festival which only happens once every twelve years, BSGP! It will soon start! Who might everyone be rooting for?"
BS35-054: "Come, today as well, for the sake of gastronomy, let us flourish this silver knife. Fruitsels, offer your bodies for my sake."
BS35-055: "Big Sis, getting too focused in cuisine would cause trouble to the race...remember that our objective is something else."
BS35-056: "Wirians" is a team famous for being comprised of Beast Heads alone, who will run dangerously and do anything for the sake of winning. However, there are many fans attracted by that dirty appeal. The observers' seats are always overflowing with poorly-behaved hooligans. Sensible BSGP fans, since it's dangerous, should not approach them!
BS35-057: "Terra Stampede" is called the Kings of the Land. Starting with the Pig God-King, Racer Calamity-Boar, they have other powerful racers like Dos-Deimos registered. However, if we're talking where this team stands out, it's of course, the best part of BSGP, big crashes!
BS35-058: Falling behind, Racer Calamity-Boar starts roaring! No, he starts going wild! A good half of the following group is caught up and blown away from the course!
BS35-059: The one who got away from the following group's crash was Racer Dos-Deimos! Racer Dos-Deimos is a member of "Terra Stampede". He now runs shouldering hope in place of Calamity-Boar, who crashed!
BS35-060: I found him. It's Racer Ricky-Mouchuu, sneakily running alongside Racer Dos-Daimos and using his giant body as a windbreaker.
BS35-061: The reason why the crew of "Terra Stampede" have physiques as good as the racers is to stop the racers who are on a rampage as they come into the pit. Oh, that tremor means... Ah! Here it comes! It's Racer Dos-Daimos' rampage, or rather, his pit stop! He's coming right this way! Gyaah, I'm going to get pulled in!
BS35-062: "Wirians" has support teams for land, sea and sky. The Marine Corps is the sea support team.
BS35-063: Oooh, Racer Dos-Deimos blows away the pursuing racers and bites at Racers Gale-Phoenix and Exeseed!
BS35-064: Wasn't the fight put up by the rookie, Racer Dos-Deimos, against two veteran God-Kings, a really, really, really great one?!
BS35-065: Coming from the east to enter the competition, "Gandala". They're known for having a profound relationship with lord JadeEmperorDragon, who held the BSGP. Will they show the miracles of God this time around too?
BS35-066: They're "Gandala"'s brother runners, Racer Wind God and Thunder God. With their synchronized combination, they're aiming for a high spot in the ranking.
BS35-073: Flowers in full glorious bloom, as if celebrating the race's start. Be careful to not be too enraptured and miss the start signal. ―Soul Spot 7/47―
BS35-074: Kilmanjack Mountain is part of a floating mountain range and is said to resemble the mountain that is a symbol of the eastern island country, Japang. It's apparently a sight that makes Japangese runners homesick. ―from the Famous Courses Report by Monthly BSGP―
BS35-075: A castle which exhibits a soul-sucking magnificence. If you get your heart stolen by its beauty, you'll eternally wander the interior of the castle. ―Soul Spot 4/47―
BS35-076: A gigantic dragon that once terrorized the world died here. Its legend continues to be told even now, and remains in the area. It is said the gigantic skeleton backs up the legend. ―From the Pursuing the Legendary Dragon feature by Monthly BSGP―
BS35-077: Walking down a footpath between trees drooping with fruits. Somewhere around here should be a Fruit of Heroes. ―Soul Spot 33/47―
BS35-078: That place is called a heaven on earth. What appear to be towering clouds are actually flying lands, and it's said that the HeavenlyWingsTrees growing there create wind. ―from Sky Stroll by Monthly BSGP―
BS35-079: The sundial which calmly marks the passage of time tells the remaining race time. ―Soul Spot 44/47―
BS35-080: While being the Headquarters of the distinguished team, "Scuderia Maclarn", it is also famous for being a fort city surrounded by gigantic walls. ―from the Scuderia Maclarn feature by Monthly BSGP―
BS35-081: Known for being the ruins of the original kitchen where food was cooked. Currently, it is under the supervision of the Gourmet Fairies, and it is said it is used for a certain ritual. ―From Visit Global Ruins by Monthly BSGP―
BS35-082: A mountain shaped like a fruit. The smoke which rises from its crater has a somewhat sweet scent. ―Soul Spot 19/47―
BS35-083: A heart-breaking slope which shatters the spirits of runners. Preparing beforehand is very important. ―Soul Spot 27/47―
BS35-084: A strange forest with giant rock faces scattered everywhere. It is a sacred ground for Fusion Beast Spirits, as well as their living space. Without exception, those who take a step in are assaulted by Fusion Beast Spirits and never return. ―From Visit Global Ruins by Monthly BSGP―
BS35-CP01: "The 216th Twelve God-Kings Battle Survival Grand Prix begins! To the 167 racers! To the limit of your strength, run, run, and run to the end!!"
BS35-X01: He left the distant eastern island country many years ago to master martial arts. Now he uses his command of the art for "Team Dragonia"'s sake as their Samurai Runner!
BS35-X02: "O Imajin... Show me your concealed powers...."
BS35-X03: "Fordelia Wings"' beautiful emerald phoenix! These well-honed wings, even if injured, will always be reborn!
BS35-X04: The God-King of Protection. "Scuderia Maclarn"'s towering giant wall!
BS35-X05: While he is the king of the fruit country, he is also the manager of "Fruits Kingdom"!
BS35-X06: "Terra Stampede"'s new strength! His rampage is earth-shaking!!
BS35-XX01: The beginning of everything lay in the six colors. Green gave the world nature.
BS35-XX02: "Six Heaven's Rush is finally accomplished… Bow down before the country-cleaving blade of the supreme ruler!!"
BS36-001: The Monaca city course has considered the safety of the spectators and buildings, and has established an attack restriction on the racers. As such, many racers have adopted lighter equipment so they can maximize speed.
BS36-002: The city course has set up something to spice up the race. As such, you can see how carefully the racers are running in the opening stretch!
BS36-003: This is the fourth time straight that Racer Exeseed has gotten on the victory stand.
BS36-004: This is an emergency bulletin from Tonio, on site. In the middle of the course, it seems that the racers in the lead were attacked from outside the race by a group calling themselves The FiveGoodDragonEmperors!
BS36-005: And Furious Charge does the trick! Aurelius has been totally repelled by the combined efforts of the God-Kings!
BS36-006: On the scene, it seems that the city has regained its calm. The band has already resumed its cheering prep. Polish-san, how are the racers who were brought to the pits?
BS36-007: The race is in turmoil because of the external attack! Racers Exeseed and Dos-Daimos have fallen behind and are ready to strike back!
BS36-008: We haven't caught up with the evacuation of the spectators in the city yet... Tonio-san, please report from the scene!
BS36-009: Proceeding at top form, Racers Exeseed and Dos-Daimos have left the group and take the lead! The race is just getting started; is there anyone who can stop them!?
BS36-010: Aurelius, the ringleader of The FiveGoodDragonEmperors, has mowed down the racers and arrived on course!
BS36-011: "Team Turon" has won second and seventh place. Their use of Imagins makes their race style formidable. Racer Ourovorius especially gives the impression of being heartless, but he's won even while carrying out his duties as a God-King! The God-Kings really are something special!
BS36-012: The special reward from the Country of Monaca will be the key to unlocking the secret of the Imagine. If a BSGP participant has it, we can wait for a chance to steal it. It will not interfere with our plan. ―■■■ Report―
BS36-013: Racer Amethyst-Dragon has just now reached the goal in sixth place! ... Oh, excuse me. Seventh place. The thing rolling across the goal is apparently a racer.
BS36-014: The last stretch of the course is once again a Monaca city. The tired and wounded racers are greeted by warm applause from the audience. That's all from Tonio's course report.
BS36-015: The God-Kings used their powers to protect the spectators and other racers from the attack, and ended up being unable to use their full potential in the race.
BS36-016: The racers injured by the attack and brought into their pits seem to have had their choice of light equipment for the course backfire on them.
BS36-017: Competing for the last two spots for victory are Racers Hanumerlin, Gale-Phoenix, and Wedgetail. Pay attention to their last fights before the goal!
BS36-018: Is this the same Spellbind that Racer Ourovorius broke out in the second match? The intense fervor of the FiveGoodDragonEmperors is weakening!
BS36-019: The God-Kings managed to repelled The FiveGoodDragonEmperors, but the damage is already done. What's going to happen to the race!?
BS36-020: The opening stretch of the Monaca GP course is a city with rows of fairy tale-like buildings. Be careful of the narrow lanes, frequent curves, and devious traps.
BS36-021: Racer Sonicwasp, who's been in the lead since the start and bravely fought against the FiveGoodDragonEmperors, pushed away Racer Ourovorius with his prided acceleration!
BS36-022: The hottest pick in this race is a winner of the Rudea GP third match and member of the "Bugs" team known for using the latest Imagine, Racer Sonicwasp.
BS36-023: "Bugs" takes in a lot of up-and-coming speedy insect racers. They're working hard to push out their first God-King.
BS36-024: "Bugs", braved with the latest Imagine, is pushing back at the FiveGoodDragonEmperors!
BS36-025: As to be expected of the "Bugs" team members! Both racers and fighters, they're not at all afraid of the dangers hindering the race!
BS36-026: Though Racer Gale-Phoenix damaged his wings in battle, with the support of Racer Wedgetail, he managed to slide into 10th place.
BS36-027: Racer Sonicwasp evades the traps and springs into the lead with his sharp flying!
BS36-028: Racer Gale-Phoenix soars, and Racer Calamity-Boar stampedes! It's a never-seen-before dream team between two God-Kings!
BS36-029: In the Rudea GP third match, Racer Mammo-Aegis of "Scuderia Maclarn" helped to raise Racer Glorious-Sheep's rank up and won with him. What will he show us in Monaca?
BS36-030: Relaying from the scene of the attack in the middle of the race. The racers of "Scuderia Maclarn" have raised their shields and are protecting the spectators from the fierce attacks of the FiveGoodDragonEmperors!
BS36-031: Racers injured in the battle with the FiveGoodDragonEmperors are being brought into the pits one after another. It seems that Racer Glorious-Sheep is also retiring...
BS36-032: Following after Racer Amethyst-Dragon, Racer Mammo-Aegis also reaches the goal. The obstinacy of "Scuderia Maclarn" really shone through!
BS36-033: A slight departure from the city, the middle ground of the course is a tranquil, rural course lined with orchards where the fragrance of fruit hangs in the air.
BS36-034: Since the attack by the FiveGoodDragonEmperors in the middle was an irregularity, there might be some massively unexpected results this time.
BS36-035: Warm applause and shouts from the audience go out to all the racers who made the goal line! It was a wonderful race. I, Harold, would again like to salute the racers who protected Monaca and finished the race! Congratulations on staying till the end!
BS36-036: Thanks to the dedication of the God-Kings, many participants were able to return to the race.
BS36-037: Racer Ourovorius, congratulations on getting second place! You were able to return to the race quickly and get a good position, but the struggle right before the goal was toug- hey, don't ignore me! ...He seems to be worked up over losing first place.
BS36-038: The Monaca GP is a home race for team "Delicious Cook". One look at the GourmetFairies and their fans surge forward!
BS36-039: The stage of the fourth match in the BSGP is a city with sweet smells and colorful buildings. It's the land of treats and fairies, Monaca.
BS36-040: At the very start of the race, melted chocolate flows onto the roadway, halting the grounded racers, and the flying racers are having a tough time getting caught in cotton candy clouds. On the other hand, "Delicious Cook"'s familiarity with the course gives them an excellent start.
BS36-041: Racer Hanumerlin, one of the current God-Kings, is using its secret arts to fight Aurelius!
BS36-042: "Delicious Cook" took the fourth place, and "Fruits Kingdom" took the sixth place this time. It's the result of them making the best of their home course advantage.
BS36-043: Racer Amethyst-Dragon blows something away right before the goal!
BS36-044: Racer Fromage is the prince of the GourmetFairies. In her motherland of Monaca, we can expect a race where she makes full use her home advantage.
BS36-045: "I will guide you to a place where the attacks won't reach you~. Please come this way~"
BS36-046: After the racers run through, the race's urban spectators take a break. It's lunch time for them until the racers come back around the circuit. Wait, what? Racer Bontan, don't eat lunch with them, run~!
BS36-047: I received some comments from the "Fruits Kingdom" cheering squad. This year's racers are all top seed. It seems Racer Kyo-Houn's seeds are especially impressive.
BS36-048: Racer Calamity-Boar has caused a lot of crashes with stampeding in this BSGP and has a generally poor record, but this time he has a decent start. Will his race be as flashy as usual now?
BS36-049: In the chaos, Racer Dos-Deimos passes up the lead and strikes back at the FiveGoodDragonEmperors! He's fighting against them for his team and the audience!
BS36-050: This time "Terra Stampede" seems to be well coordinated with their Imagine, and their racers are in a good mood. Calamity-Boar isn't crashing as well. Seems that they can get good results!
BS36-051: Racer Dos-Deimos is retiring due to injury this time, but in praise of his fight against the FiveGoodDragonEmperors, the land of Monaca is sending him desserts.
BS36-052: Racer Calamity-Boar has just reached the goal, straining for the sake of the forcibly retired Racer Dos-Deimos! Now half of the winning spots are filled!
BS36-053: Could the FiveGoodDragonEmperors have been aiming for the prize given to the winners of Monaca GP?
BS36-054: Racer Fromage escapes Calamity-Boar's hot pursuit and reaches the goal!
BS36-055: Although there are some doubts about resuming the race suspended due to the FiveGoodDragonEmperors' attack, we've been notified that by decree of Lord Daiteiou, the race will continue.
BS36-056: I've been told that the race will continue, and that the racers have started up all at once again. That's all from Tonio, on scene. Back to Harold-san's coverage.
BS36-066: Don't think you'll be allowed to fly over these dunes because "the footing is bad". ―Soul Spot 31/47―
BS36-067: There is a phantom village thick with riches said to be at the foot of a certain mountain. Many search for it, but nobody has found it and come back alive. -Soul Spot 16/47-
BS36-068: An ancient castle abandoned in a war long ago. Eventually it was grown over and forgotten along with the war. -Soul Spot 8/47-
BS36-069: The fortress is in a state of high alert no matter the time of day. There are a lot of excessive labels in the fortress. Safety first, Keep clean, Fingerprint identification... They seem to run a tight ship. -Soul Spot 28/47-
BS36-070: A fruity temple that smells like sweet apples. It's a culturally important structure, so don't bite into it. -Soul Spot 29/47-
BS36-071: A giant scarlet gate that can be seen at open sea. The ropes hanging from the gates apparently ward off disasters from the ocean. -Soul Spot 47/47-
BS36-CP01: Not only did the current God-Kings protect everyone from the FiveGoodDragonEmperors' intrusion, five of them also ranked. Once again, they've proven just how strong they are.
BS36-CP02: Racer Wedgetail regrettably missed getting into the rankings, but did some nice support.
BS36-X01: "For the sake of my empire's prosperity, I shall take the hidden treasure into these hands."
BS36-X02: "Everlasting darkness, fasten to the very depths of the soul..."
BS36-X04: A Machine Beast fusion unit boasting extreme firmness and high mobility!
BS36-X05: "My, is it really all right for me to receive this many fruits?"
BS36-X06: Reckless charging! Inevitable crashing! It's "Terra Stampede"'s rampaging racer!
BS36-XX01: White established culture in the world. Culture brought about order, but at times birthed conflict.
BS36-XX02: Blue filled the world with the sea. The sea fostered life, but at times, stole it.
BS37-001: According to "Speed Tiger"'s pit crew, Racer Revol-Tiger is in high spirits following his excellent performance this season. He seems to be getting worked up about how he'll win against his goal, Racer Exeseed. We should keep our eyes wide-wide-wide open for his run this time!
BS37-002: "As long as I am here, that which the FiveGoodDragonEmperors used so well... Enough, entertain me with this race."
BS37-003: In the lead as the first half winds down is The TigerTwelveGodKing Revol-Tiger! Supporting him is his little brother, Bros-Tiger!
BS37-004: News flash: There was a massive accident on the descent of the hill at the start of the course. There are two individuals whose survival is still unconfirmed. Other than that, there are numerous injured. Tonio-san, we're asking for an on-site report.
BS37-005: Taking the lead at the opening are the racers of "Speed Tiger". Despite their heavy equipment, they're running through Italicia with ease!
BS37-006: When I interviewed "Felarl Racing"'s pit crew, it seemed that the racer to pay attention to this race is a promising new face that succeeds from Racer Exeseed's pedigree! Let's watch out how it races.
BS37-007: As if waiting for racer Revol-Tiger as he decelerates and falls in rank, racer Bros-Tiger also decelerates and attacks racer Revol-Tiger! Reinvigorated, racer Revol-Tiger bombards high into the sky as if breaking off something and begins to vividly accelerate once again!
BS37-008: It seems the state of the accident has just now reached Revol-Tiger, who runs ahead. Racer Exeseed is the racer who made him aim for BSGP. As expected, he cannot hide his trembling, and his running is being influenced...
BS37-009: The cool sharp glint in the eyes of the "Speed Tiger" members, as if they're hunting down their prey, shows the zeal they've put into the race, and is really cool!
BS37-010: Since "Ferarl Racing"'s home is Italicia, their numerous fans have flocked to this event.
BS37-011: Racer Revol-Tiger has recovered from despair and is gaining at high speed as he scatters the forerunners with bombardment. He's lost all hesitation! He's running at full speed toward the goal!
BS37-012: As we approach the middle half, Revol-Tiger of "Speed Tiger" is going down in the rankings. That previous incident must have been a cause for worry.
BS37-013: Swayed by the "Speed Tiger" racers' start dash, champion racers like Exeseed and Ourovorius are going at quite a high pace in the first half!
BS37-014: From here we can see the scene of the accident in an uproar, and the audience seems disturbed too. It seems to have been caused by racers Exeseed and Ourovorius colliding. Both racers have already been brought in to the relief area, but there's no word on their condition.
BS37-015: What possibly could have been the cause for the accident? While the site is being investigated to discover the cause, the way things are going, nothing will be discovered.... This was Tonio, on site.
BS37-016: Racer Ourovorius, right at the start of the course, leaves a thorough mark on Racer Exeseed through Spellbind. This is the fate of a victory candidate!
BS37-017: The loss of Ourovorius has caused a need to change the plans. But the delay won't be a problem. ―■■■ Report―
BS37-018: "Team Turon" ranked in fourth and seventh places. A result obtained despite of the loss of Ourovorius. They're no doubt worthy of being called a top class champion team.
BS37-019: Many conjectures float about from the testimonies at the site, such as Racer Exeseed's tumbling causing the accident, or that Racer Ourovorius' attack was the source of it.
BS37-020: Due to the Accel equipment no longer being forbidden from the tournament, the racers' standard speed level seems to have increased. Whether they can master its use or not depends on the skill of the runner.
BS37-021: Racer Amethyst-Dragon has the real skill to continually support the God-Kings of "Team Turon" while still breaking into the rankings himself.
BS37-022: Racer Amethyst-Dragon once again gets into the rankings with a steady running pace. If he keeps going this way, won't he be getting a rank that allows him to aim for the seat of God-King?
BS37-023: Obituary notice: We've received news of the deaths of both Racer Exeseed and Racer Ourovorius.
BS37-024: The venue of the seventh battle of the BSGP is a temperate townscape that marks the passage of time. It's the country of blue skies and historic ruins, Italicia.
BS37-025: The one to wade through and leave the "Bugs"'s swarm is "Felarl Racing"'s new face!
BS37-026: Ooooh, Racer Mistral-Bit has ornately passed through "Scuderia Maclarn"'s Wall and is picking up the pace!
BS37-027: The previous accident has thrown the site into chaos. Tonio-san, please give us a detailed situation report on the scene.
BS37-028: Will the formation commanded by Glorious-Sheep stop even the miniscule racers of "Bugs"?!
BS37-029: In the middle half, "Scuderia Maclarn" overtakes racer Mistral-Bit with a quick recovery!
BS37-030: Racer Mistral-Bit's initial speed was worth noting, and the stretch in front of the goal was also incredible! Amethyst-Dragon, who's been in great condition this season, has shown the persistence of a God-King!
BS37-031: When the big accident happened, the first ones to act were the "Fordelia Wings" racers. They quickly delivered the racers involved on the accident to the first aid staff.
BS37-032: "Fordelia Wings"' Racer Air Eraser rides on the wind and gains position in a moment! Will it be able to aim for the rankings?
BS37-033: This is the debut of the other ace racer from "Bugs", who carries the title of "A." Its blue body is truly befitting of its "Blue Comet" name.
BS37-034: Aerial racers from "Bugs" and "Fordelia Wings" are being expertly contained by Racer Solid-Falco.
BS37-035: Racer Air Eraser is the team's secret ace. The conflict between his fans and Gale Phoenix's is fierce... or so they say.
BS37-036: For this race, "Scuderia Maclarn" seems to have prepared an astounding secret weapon, other than the favorite Racer Glorious-Sheep. It might have to do with the new equipment, Accel...
BS37-037: The Machine Beast team of "Scuderia Maclarn", in a calm start, runs slightly behind Racer Exeseed during the start of the course.
BS37-038: This is Polish, before the start line! With Racer Glorious-Sheep at the lead position, the team is getting in formation. Could this blue Machine Beast at the center be a new weapon?
BS37-039: Rather inclined towards rampaging, Racer Turborex catches up to Racer Hanumerlin while routing its surroundings!
BS37-040: Under racer Glorious-Sheep's orders, Scuderia Maclarn recovered from the chaos after the accident and got back into formation. They're currently on the heels of racer Hanumerlin, who slipped away from the confused crowd.
BS37-041: "Scuderia Maclarn" had its formation broken by Racer Turborex's rampaging, but the anticipated new machine ranked in fifth place after winning a tough battle against Racer Mistral-Bit.
BS37-042: The "Scuderia Maclarn" group has once more captured Racer Mistral-Bit! This stability even at the end of the course can be attributed to nothing other than the strength of the team!
BS37-043: "Scuderia Maclarn"'s impenetrable formations don't give an opening even overhead.
BS37-044: Racer Turborex breaks free from his team members restraints and lets out a spurt! Was Scuderia Maclarn's formation a plan to preserve him?!
BS37-045: At the point where one can almost see the Colosseum, Racer Turborex and Racer Hanumerlin fight for the lead.
BS37-046: Did Racer Turborex rampage too much and run out of energy?
BS37-047: It can instantly respond with a zone-adapted form when thrown into a predicament!?
BS37-048: It seems that racer Mouchuu just doesn't feel like participating this time and has left the team, Lunar Racing, in Racer Hanumerlin's hands!
BS37-049: The racer who got into the rankings at Monaca GP has removed its costume and entered Serious Mode. That earnest gaze staring at the goal.... But wait, that's not the right road, you know?!
BS37-050: Lunar Racing's Racer Hanumerlin makes use of a strategy that used the push of his team member's Accel to speed up in one stretch!
BS37-051: The pit crew that Racer Hanumerlin directly supervises is well versed in Accel. They can quickly catch any abnormalities and instantly deal with them.
BS37-052: "Fruits Kingdom"'s fans seem to be more interested in the ripe fruits than the result of the race.
BS37-053: "Doctor Hanumerlin. Let us accept their request for cooperation. Do not forget their provision of bananas to our kingdom."
BS37-054: Running as if to be close to his "Lunar Racing" team members, Racer Hanumerlin races at the back of the leading group at the beginning of the race.
BS37-055: God-King Racer Hanumerlin goes first in the race, earnestly breaking down the gloomy atmosphere caused by the accident! He's climbing up to the head in one swoop with the power of his team!
BS37-056: "Hey, Monkeys! Don't get so full of yourselves!"
BS37-057: After the race, Racer Revol-Tiger is going to vent his rage at "Team Turon", but Racer Hanumerlin and other God-Kings advise against it! Could "Team Turon" really be at fault for the accident?
BS37-058: Among the "Fruits Kingdom" racers, there are also ones who specialize in temperate regions.
BS37-059: At the end, despite even using Turborex's Accel to compete for first place, Racer Hanumerlin regrettably loses to Racer Revol-Tiger by a cannon's length.
BS37-060: Judging by the site's condition, after contacting each other, they clashed on a stone wall. Fresh vestiges have been left on the stone wall it is thought they clashed on. This was Tonio, on site.
BS37-061: Gandala's royalty members have taken the visitor seats. I'm asking you to earnestly not make any blunders, okay, Polish?
BS37-062: Is Gandala's central racer, as expected, Racer Vishten? I approve of him as a hottie racer!
BS37-063: "Terra Stampede" also has some racers installing Accel~
BS37-064: Racer Dos-Deimos was blocked by "Scuderia Maclarn"'s formation. He couldn't move forward in the early stage of the course and seems to be at a loss on how to attack.
BS37-065: The opening course starts at a low hill, from where you can see a townscape of beautiful stone structures all in a row. Watch out for the steep slope on the way down.
BS37-066: "Terra Stampede" is structured to back up Racer Dos-Deimos with all their strength. And Racer Calamity-Boar... seems to be in a sink or swim situation as usual!
BS37-067: The racers shoot for the colosseum in the last half of the course. The last stop of their fight is a land where veteran heroes fought. That's all from Tonio's Course Report.
BS37-068: The middle half of the course runs straight along a beautiful transparent ocean. This is the best place to use Accel, but be sure you don't go too fast.

BS39-033: The fight against the FourDemonLords was rough. Racers Glorious-SHeep, Calamity-Boar, and Hanumerlin are focusing on recuperation for the time being. Ah, two monkeys have come to deliver a message from racer Hanumerlin.
BS39-034: From the back of Racer Dos-Deimos, pulling his last spurt, jumps forth Racer Roborov, throws forth Racer Mouchuu! And now over Avalanche-Bison! What acrobatics! Racer Mouchuu keeps increasing positions!
BS39-035: Racer Mouchuu, along with racers Gale-Phoenix and Tiamadou, went to the bottom of the EvilGod to carry out their duties as TwelveGodKings. Racer Mouchuu is hard to read, but gets the job done when needed.
BS39-036: The race is over, and Queen Mangosteena presents the victory with a bouquet. Ah, Racer Mouchuu? "There's no time for that! Scurry up and make Seburn a GodKing!"
BS39-037: Racer Chinchilla gets a good position on the final portion of the race. Whoa, Racer Chinchilla disappears and who appears is no one else other than Racer Mouchuu! Weren't you supposed to be fighting the Evil God-King?!
BS39-038: "This is awful, if Lady Eclair's baking is offered, the race's prizewinners will be devastated! I've got to let them know right away, don't get in my way!!"
BS39-039: Racer Hanumerlin is already guaranteed a TwelveGodKing spot points-wise. It seems "Lunar Racing" is heading to deal with the EvilGod forthwith.
BS39-040: This is "Fruits Kingdom"'s secret weapon, dragonfruit. Is it tasty?
BS39-041: The "Wirian" racers seem to be constantly in-fighting as well. Because even the racers with multiple heads have the heads arguing among each other.
BS39-042: The plan will be carried out at noon during the Abul-Dharbi GP. Six GodKings are of little importance. The EvilGodKing who I saw beyond the "i Gate" then will finally be revived. ―To■io Report―
BS39-043: "We ain't playing dirty cuz we like it. We just can't go against our Bro Greedog..."
BS39-044: "Terra Stampede" must be contriving to make racer Dos-Deimos a TwelveGodKing. Racer Disaster-Boar is focusing exclusively on hindering racer Air Eraser behind them.
BS39-045: "So three of the TwelveGodKings have headed to the EvilGod and entrusted the race to rookies. Then shall we of Gandala go to castigate the perpetrator?"
BS39-046: Racer Twin-Head Beagle sacrifices himself to cut open a path! Racer Doberdog catches up to Racer Exeseburn and Racer Amethyst-Dragon!
BS39-047: The only one with clean racing in "Wirian", which runs roughly a lot, is Racer Doberdog. It's this sort of individual you want becoming a Twelve God-King.
BS39-060: An ultra high-speed and exciting circuit that runs long and straight right before the goal, where racer Revol-Tiger first won a GP and cemented their inauguration as GodKing. ―from the Famous Courses report by Monthly BSGP―
BS39-061: A God-King temple which dates back to the first BSGP tournament. Every God-King is appointed to their roles on this altar, and here they are enshrined.
BS39-062: The Phoenix takes a long time to revive, and thus evolves into stronger and faster forms.
BS39-063: A technical circuit where many BSGPs were once held. A great number of famous matches took place at this ground. ―Soul Spot 24/47―
BS39-064: The sacred territory of Fruitsels where the golden fruit is enshrined. The water that runs in this river is said to be as sweet as nectar. ―Soul Spot 14/47―
BS39-065: Beautiful fireworks fill the sky, lighting up the night as if it were midday. Are they celebrating the birth of the new GodKings? ―Soul Spot 41/47―
BS39-RV001: From the skies, he soars to distant lands in search of food. All who are reflected in the sharp glint of his eyes quickly become his prey. —from the Aquila chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV002: Purification of a world disrupted by selfishness. Its proud pure white horn pointing to the heavens is the advent of noble will. —from the Unicorn chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV003: If you make light of the fact he's just a child, expect to be sent to the afterlife in the next few seconds. He has had a heightened sense of battle since the day he was born. BS39-RV004: Whoever determined that dogs are the definition of loyalty? BS39-RV005: The dancing mad magician surrenders its body to the burning flames, guiding the targeted soul to a pitch-black hell far darker than the forest abyss. —from the Serpens chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV006: The inquisitive mind strays from ethics and yields to the ways of the wicked deity. —from the Ophiuchus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS39-RV008: Though still unrefined, his superior speed and presence already makes for the number one shine on the battlefield. His unclouded face reminds me of a Braver from the past. —from the Canis Major chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV009: A bird whose color is nothing like anything seen in this world and a chirp ever so mysterious. Is it just a dream? Or can this creature be real? It's like gazing upon the ultimate mirage. —from the Apus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV010: The eyes of a young warrior-in-training views battles as grand festivals. To him, the battlefield is a playground, and the erasing of others' lives becomes the ultimate pastime. —from the Lynx chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV011: Radiating seven-colored light and group swimming in the sea of the sunrise's glow, the golden meteor shower grants wishes. —Astral Scholar Lyria, Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights, the Volans Chronicles—
BS39-RV012: They send information by emitting their messages as sound waves indecipherable by other beings. BS39-RV013: The fearsome and authoritative satellite cannon has another side to it; an autonomously acting mode for intercepting joined enemy forces. —from the Telescopium chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV014: By the wish of the stars, the ancient PhantomLord was reborn. —from the Camelopardalis chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV015: Unconditional cuteness that makes one forgive everything. BS39-RV016: Beauty is an immortal thing. —from the Pavo chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV017: Because she's imprisoned, she knows what freedom is. Her desire for release calls forth a pulsating power from within. —from the Andromeda chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV018: The shine of the golden hair she takes pride in, itself, as if having its own will, splendidly flutters and captures the enemy. —from the Comae Berenices chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV019: The divine earth inherited from the forefathers lets out a scream for the continuing great war. Knowing of its grief and wishing to end it, his forceful arrow shrieks and pierces through the enemy. —from the Indus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV020: The Golem sent for the victory celebration was said to have destroyed a gigantic gate from the inside. —from the Centaurus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV021: The armor in which it was clad also controlled and camouflaged its power. Now that it has taken off its restraints, the warrior's suicide attack cannot be stopped by anybody. —from the Centaurus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV022: He is a grizzled war veteran. When he enters the battlefield, "destruction" is far too simple a word to describe the outcome. —from the Orion chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV023: The revival of the giant Golem was brought about by the possessor of a strong will to never give up, so that the great war between Sun and Moon which had lasted long with many sacrifices would come to an end. —from the Argo chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV024: To him, life is but stardust in the night sky. —from the Draco chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV025: The wolf's own instinct spurs him on to battle. —from the Lupus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS39-RV028: This place is imbued with godlike power. Mysteriously, battles never occur here. —from the Mensa chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV029: There is said to be a legendary sword of unknown make and material that can withstand heat of any degree without melting. BS39-RV030: Is the sculpture in the mansion where no one can enter the figure of a god or the embodiment of a devil? Nevertheless, as nobody can enter, this is all speculation. —from the Sculptor chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV031: It is said that when completed, the scene depicted in the painting would become real. Is the canvas' picture the end of this world, or is it... —from the Pictor chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV032: Two giant trees supporting each other. I can't help but see them as the sun and moon. With the sun alone or the moon alone, the world will lose its balance. BS39-RV033: The warriors of the Lunar Brigade continually bear serious injuries. Ether alone is extracted from the light of the paling moon, and is intensely discharged on their wounds. BS39-RV034: The architects of the Lunar Brigade's ultimate weapon could not possibly be these two: a strange penguin astronomer, and a handicraft little fairy with a golden hammer, right? —from the Telescopium chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV035: There are few travelers who are not hurt by the steep triangular crags or the sharp grass. Also, if your luck is bad you may meet a strange angel; it's a dangerous place in many ways. —from the Norma chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV036: The disappeared legendary constellation stands out on the great sail. Now that everything has been completed, it's only a matter of time until the revival of that Golem. —from the Vela chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
BS39-RV037: As if winding back a clock, the scattered pieces of the puzzle are set in their proper places. BS39-RVX01: He is in a world surpassing all knowledge. —from the Taurus chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—

BS39-RVX05: The last justice is with her. —from the Virgo chronicles of "Tales of Eighty-Eight Starlit Nights" by Astronomer Lilia—
