BS40-001: Even after the Grand Collapse, the world did not die out. The world is amazing. But lots of problems developed. Mainly, the discord between species. The issue is with the inhabitants.
BS40-002: The Terra Dragons have a historically bad relationship with the other Red World species. It's because they think they're the best.
BS40-003: The Red World is only bounded by itself, and even the Winged Dragons cannot cross to the neighboring worlds.
BS40-004: One of my escorts is a swordsmaster. He's as taciturn as he looks yet more sensitive than he seems. It's because he's a half-breed of two opposite species.
BS40-005: The main characteristic of the "Great Collapse Era" is that the world was divided into 6, but the coherent countries collapsing and primitive conflicts beginning as if time wound back were also major changes. -from the 1st section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter Red-
BS40-006: It'd be a lot better if we didn't have to give the Terra Dragons the power of Advent. The pyroxene heroes are bizarrely serious.
BS40-007: Move out of the way! There's a gate to another world ahead of there!
BS40-008: A red light is released from the Original Pyroxene, heading towards the sky.... Right now, somewhere, someone is Adventing...
BS40-009: It is "Advent," not just a transformation. All is done by the power of the "Original Pyroxene"...
BS40-010: In the world, there is a source of power called the "Original Pyroxene". It is protected by the chosen heroes and their descendants.
BS40-011: We used the power of the Original Pyroxene, why is it attacking us!!
BS40-012: Though this is now the Red World, it used to be a single realm. These Spirits who were visiting the Red World at the time of the Great Collapse were unable to return to their own worlds, with many left stranded. -from the 1st section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter Red-
BS40-013: I know. Our mission is to find the legendary Saviour. ...But I can't just abandon the Spirits who can't return to their own worlds and are now caught up in battle, can I!?
BS40-014: After the Great Collapse, a riot was instigated in the Red World by Terra Dragons and Ogre Wizards. "The First Red War" was stabilized through the efforts of the Searchers. The power of the TwinkleDragonEmperor Advented by one of the escorts was said to be tremendous. -from the 1st section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter Red-
BS40-015: One of my escorts is a conjurer. While I can only consider him to be a narcissist, he is very crude. At least aim before you attack with the offensive spells please.
BS40-016: After settling "The First Red War" , the Searchers were guided by the feather of the bird and set out for the Gate connecting to another world. -from the 1st section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter Red-
BS40-017: You'll lend us the power of pyroxene? Thank you. I'll do something to end this uprising quickly, for your sakes as well.
BS40-018: Advent isn't perfect... if too much damage is taken while Adventing, one might be depleted after the Advent is undone...
BS40-019: The rebellion of the Terra Dragons... Someone might have pulled the strings behind it.
BS40-020: It's a battle between Advented Spirits!! Don't lose to the Terra Dragons!!
BS40-021: The power of the purple pyroxene? But this is the Red World, can it really cross dimensions!?
BS40-022: So it was you guys!! You're the ones who incited the Terra Dragons!!
BS40-023: Vegetation that's plainly different from my birthland's, and insect Spirits that I've never seen before... we've successfully passed through the Gate!
BS40-024: Led by the birds, the Searcher Alex reacher the red "Origin Pyroxene". The pyroxene hero and their followers awaited them there, to pass on an important mission... -from the 1st section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter Red-
BS40-025: After passing through the Red World's Gate, they arrived in the Green World. They would realize something crucial there. -from the 1st section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter Green-
BS40-026: One of my escorts is an acrobat. Yet why is he so composed!? He's the lighest of all of us, but brings up the rear. Is it because he's actually the oldest?
BS40-027: The Red World couldn't rein in its denizens and entered a state of war. The Green World is facing a completely different issue. Shall I call it nature running wild? What's with this jungle and violent rainstorms!?
BS40-028: Amid a terrible wind, an amazing great leap!! Please, bring back the heroes of the pyroxene!!
BS40-029: I realized something overwhelming and lost all strength... What can I do about this feeling of exhaustion... None of us know what Lolo looks like...
BS40-030: With things as they are, we can't have the birds guide us till the Origin Pyroxene. That's why you coming along really helped.
BS40-031: What do you mean, the pyroxene hero is missing!? You're looking for them too!?
BS40-032: Advent isn't meant to be done just for fighting... I have never thought that it could even be used to shrink oneself...
BS40-033: Denizens of the Blue World!? They're the ones who took away the hero!?
BS40-034: The trees don't rustle, the waves are still, the effects of the heaviness are unfathomable. It's amazing that you all can move without a problem...
BS40-035: The White World seriously freaked me out. The atmosphere is nothing but heavy. I'm not talking about the social atmosphere here, see? It's physically heavy. Without a machine body, it takes a lot of effort just to move.
BS40-036: One of my escorts has a machine body. Even so, it's a coward for some reason. It blocks, guards, and defends without fighting back. All it does is hide behind its shield.
BS40-037: No hint leading towards the legendary Saviour was found in the Green World. Alex searched for the Gate and stepped into the next world. Lying beyond was a silver world which seemed to be frozen in time. -from the 1st section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter White-
BS40-038: I see, we can move in machine bodies if we Advent! Useful.
BS40-039: Whenever there isn't a war, we can focus on gathering intel. According to the Valkyrie, Angelias came to this land. If we ask the Angelias, we might learn something.
BS40-040: This atmosphere is getting heavier by the day? Isn't that simply a huge problem?!
BS40-041: In the age of myth, a world that stopped moving was melted by a glass diva.
BS40-042: Thank you. If you're with us, we can transport the Angelias.
BS40-043: While I can barely stand, he moves around lightly. The power of Advent is amazing!!
BS40-044: The Angelias left in the White World couldn't adapt to the increase in gravity caused by the Great Collapse and became unable to move. If they Advented, they would be able to move slightly at least... Alex and company guided the self-serving angels to the white Origin Pyroxene to teach them the method for it. -from the 1st section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter White-
BS40-045: Shrinking one's body reduces the effects of gravity... well, I can understand why the pretty Angelias wouldn't want to become tiny rats though.
BS40-046: Tired, sleepy, hungry, sun's too bright, night's too cold. Grass is green, cats over dogs... well, you all are annoying.
BS40-047: One of my escorts is a magician. She acts cheerful, but is actually very serious. Her favorite words are effort, willpower, and moral obligation.
BS40-048: Still unable to salvage the world, Alex and escorts left the White World behind them. However, they did not yet know that a new enemy was about to arrive who would shift their journey's focus from searching to combat. -from the end of the 1st section of "New Record of the Strange World"-
BS40-049: A companion, huh? Even if it's someone from really long ago, could they still be somewhere today? I felt it was incredible information, but it didn't really lead to anything in the end, did it...
BS40-050: The Emperor now accompanying them claimed to know a legendary companion. Having discovered their greatest clue yet, they decided to next venture to the Yellow World. -from the 1st section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter White-
BS40-051: That's a pretty stuck-up looking penguin... What!? You know a companion!? You'll bring us to the Yellow World!?
BS40-052: The partners that traveled with the Saviour. They've become beings of legend now.
BS40-053: Thanks to the "Original Pyroxene", the Angelias also became able to Advent.
BS40-054: Could it be because it advented over an angel...? It's somewhat divine...
BS40-055: There were a large number of humanoid Spirits from the blue Ocean Empire left behind in the Green World. They could not adapt to the rapidly changing environment and depended on the pyroxene hero to return them to their nation. -from the 1st section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter Green-
BS40-056: The hero protecting the green Origin Pyroxene seems to be quite good-natured. Apparently he accompanied the giant who pretends to be in distress.
BS40-057: One of my escorts is a lancer. He looks kind, but is quite the opposite. He once nonchalantly told me that his favorite thing is seeing others anguished...
BS40-058: One of the escorts who had leapt up to where the pyroxene hero was at further Advented with a TwinBlade Emperor on the spot. It was to prepare for battle against the Giants. -from the 1st section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter Green-
BS40-059: The heroes of the Origin Pyroxene protect the stone and draw out the power of Advent. The power has an effect in other worlds, but the Gates connecting realms are out of its domain. However, the Giants did not trust this explanation. -from the 1st section of "New Record of the Strange World", chapter Green-
BS40-060: The Giant also advented!! Once again, a battle between two Advent Spirits!
BS40-061: I've got it! The ones with two heads are minions of the Giants!
BS40-062: Some foreign species seem to have adapted to the Green World. Beasts of those types are the ones who instrumented the hero's kidnapping.
BS40-063: So that's the ringleader!! He's just as pompous and tough-looking as I expected!!
BS40-064: The Giants Advented again!? Who's giving them the power!?
BS40-065: To be that huge and not even flinch under such a tempest!
BS40-066: An odd rock that warped into a strange shape by way of the Great Collapse. If you go south at this landmark, you'll end up at the Terra Dragons' stronghold. -from the Places of Interest 110/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-
BS40-067: One of the remaining artifacts of an ancient dynasty that united the red continent. It's believed that ones called "Heroes" ruled over it. -from the Places of Interest 408/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-
BS40-068: The worlds changed mostly for the worse because of the Great Collapse, but conversely, some places became magnificent. This flower is an uncommon example of such. Though it looks like glass, it has a sweet fragrance. -from the Places of Interest 188/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-
BS40-069: It's supposed to be from an era of myth when the legendary Saviour lived, predating even ancient times, but that is dubious. -from the Places of Interest 503/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-
BS40-070: A bird's nest at the world's highest elevation. You can't approach it when the parent birds are present, so just watching it takes a lot of luck. Hence, it's become a famous spot for testing one's luck. Touching the egg is absolutely not recommended. -from the Places of Interest 627/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-
BS40-071: The propagation of plants has accelerated considerably thanks to the Great Collapse. As such, this strange area looks like it has a long history, but is relatively new, making such a rare view. Be sure to bring Green tea with you for a visit. -from the Places of Interest 245/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-
BS40-072: The Great Collapse caused motion around the entire White World to become sluggish as if time had stopped for it. This wave is a representative example; though it looks like it is stopped, it actually moves a few millimeters per day. -from the Places of Interest 163/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-
BS40-073: In the past, a world called the "Reverse Continent" appeared in the skies above. This is the battleship that supposedly brought Ultimates from there. -from the Places of Interest 766/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-
BS40-074: The denizens' senses went crazy thanks to the Great Collapse, enabling a certain genius to craft this masterpiece. The cream and fruits are replenished every day. It's genuinely delicious. -from the Places of Interest 374/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-
BS40-075: When the Solar Militia and Lunar Brigade clashed, the Twelve Zodiac Spirits made peace in the shrine supposedly in this city. -from the Places of Interest 812/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-
BS40-076: Due to the Great Collapse, the Blue World's land and water levels reversed, making the many dry areas in the past sink underwater. This place was submerged as well, but became more mystical as a result. The sunset here, in particular, is a must-see. -from the Places of Interest 339/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-
BS40-077: The relic of a legendary Spirit called the "Companion". It should have come with a voicing tool called a microphone, but it seems to have gone missing. -from the Places of Interest 006/1000 of "New Record of the Strange World"-
BS40-079: "Thanks for the battle. It was a nice fight."

BS40-CP02: The Green Pyroxene controls life. All growth is found under green.
BS40-CP03: The White Pyroxene governs the land. All stability is together with white.

BS40-RV002: Dinosaurs are already aware. Don't run now. It's not dinosaurs but him who is right behind us getting impatient to take our lives.
BS40-RV003: I've been told that snakes are wise, but I'm beginning to doubt it. This one looks purely aggressive. -from the 5th paragraph in chapter Purple of "Record of the Strange World" by Wanderer Lolo"-
BS40-RV004: The ruler of fear froze the foes at the first sight, The traitors stopped resisting and threw themselves at their feet.
